page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number left and title right; one text column on the right of a ruled frame, with a faint ghosted text column behind it (show-through, not transcribed); a woodcut ornament below the text; catchword/signature line at foot with "SECT." at right.

main_text.p: strorum meritum, satisfactio-nem humanam; Indulgentias, Purgatorium, Peccati diffe-rentias ordine quodam suo versantur. Hæc mihi pri-mulùm discutienda occurrunt.

page.notes: The woodcut floral ornament between the text and the foot rule is not transcribed. Faint show-through text from the reverse page is ignored. The word "SECT." at the lower right is treated as a catchword. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The first word "strorum" is a fragment continuing from the previous page.
